item.title: 🌐 Universal Parser
item.description:
Note: The Universal Parser is only available in DefectDojo Pro.

The Universal Parser is currently in Beta. See our announcement presentation for more information.

item.title: Using Generic Findings Import
item.description: Generic Findings Import lets open-source and Pro users bring findings from a tool DefectDojo has no parser for. You convert the tool’s output into DefectDojo’s own CSV or JSON format, then import it like any other scan.
